title: Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2608.14642v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods

translated_title: 在每回合分布上训练与评估道德强化学习代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14642v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在单一奖励信号上训练的强化学习（RL）代理会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距。当我们试图将道德行为注入RL代理时，这一问题尤为突出。一个代理可能在平均表现上看起来合乎道德，但其违规行为集中在少数几个糟糕的回合中，环境中一个生物在一个回合中受到的伤害不会因另一个回合中的良好行为而得到恢复。我们比较了四种在开放式生存基准Craftax中训练道德行为的方法。这四种方法是：带终止的标量惩罚、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应拉格朗日约束，以及在预期标量化回报（ESR）标准下每回合优化的非补偿性效用。所有方法均在单一基于检测器的协议下进行评估，该协议对每个回合中的每次违规都进行计数，不进行删减。在平均回报对平均违规率的前沿上，这四种方法...
tldr: 本文比较了四种在Craftax基准中训练道德强化学习代理的方法，并采用不删减的检测器协议评估，旨在解决代理在平均表现良好但集中违规的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper compares four methods for training ethical reinforcement learning agents in the Craftax benchmark, evaluated under an uncensored detector protocol, to address the issue of agents appearing ethical on average while concentrating violations.
